puzzle_library.pe:
Month Puzzle: 8 persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W were born in eight different months (January, February, March, April, May, June, July and August) of the same year.
* S was born in a month having 30 days.
* Only two persons were born between S and T.
* V was born in a month having 31 days immediately after T.
* Only three persons were born between V and Q.
* P was born immediately before Q.
* Only two persons were born between P and W.
* U was born before R but after W.
puzzle_library.ph:
महीना पहेली: 8 व्यक्ति P, Q, R, S, T, U, V और W एक ही वर्ष के आठ अलग-अलग महीनों (जनवरी, फरवरी, मार्च, अप्रैल, मई, जून, जुलाई और अगस्त) में पैदा हुए थे।
* S का जन्म 30 दिन वाले महीने में हुआ था।
* S और T के बीच केवल दो व्यक्ति पैदा हुए थे।
* V का जन्म T के ठीक बाद 31 दिन वाले महीने में हुआ था।
* V और Q के बीच केवल तीन व्यक्ति पैदा हुए थे।
* P का जन्म Q से ठीक पहले हुआ था।
* P और W के बीच केवल दो व्यक्ति पैदा हुए थे।
* U का जन्म R से पहले लेकिन W के बाद हुआ था।

questions.qe: Q1: Who was born in February?
questions.qh: प्रश्न 1: फरवरी में किसका जन्म हुआ था?
questions.e:
Approach: Start with S (April or June). If S is April, T is January. V is Feb (but Feb doesn't have 31 days). If S is June, T is March, V is April (30 days). Final correct order: T(Jan), V(Feb-Wait), Correct Order: W(Jan), S(Feb-Wrong).
Final Solution Table: Jan-W, Feb-P, Mar-Q, Apr-S, May-T, Jun-V, Jul-U, Aug-R. Feb contains P.

questions.qe: Q2: How many people were born between W and V?
questions.qh: प्रश्न 2: W और V के बीच कितने लोग पैदा हुए थे?
questions.e: Logic: W is Jan and V is June. Months in between: Feb, Mar, Apr, May (4 months). Answer: Four.

questions.qe: Q3: Who was born immediately after S?
questions.qh: प्रश्न 3: S के ठीक बाद कौन पैदा हुआ था?
questions.e: Logic: As per the arrangement, S was born in April and T was born in May.

questions.qe: Q4: In which month was R born?
questions.qh: प्रश्न 4: R का जन्म किस महीने में हुआ था?
questions.e: Logic: U was after W and before R. R is the last person in the sequence, born in August.

questions.qe: Q5: Find the odd one out based on the number of days in the month.
questions.qh: प्रश्न 5: महीने के दिनों की संख्या के आधार पर विषम चुनें।
questions.e: Shortcut: W(Jan-31), Q(Mar-31), V(Jun-30), S(Apr-30). Wait, check options: W, Q are 31. S is 30. Correct: S is odd if others are 31.

questions.qe: Syllogism (1/5): Statements: Only a few Books are Pens. All Pens are Pencils. No Pencil is Eraser.
questions.qh: न्याय निगमन (1/5): कथन: केवल कुछ किताबें पेन हैं। सभी पेन पेंसिल हैं। कोई पेंसिल इरेज़र नहीं है।
questions.e: Concept: Books that are Pens/Pencils cannot be Eraser because No Pencil is Eraser. So, I is definitely true. All Books cannot be Eraser (II false).

questions.qe: Syllogism (2/5): Statements: All Gold are Silver. Only a few Silver are Platinum.
questions.qh: न्याय निगमन (2/5): कथन: सभी सोना चांदी हैं। केवल कुछ चांदी प्लेटिनम हैं।
questions.e: Logic: Gold has no direct negative relation with Platinum. Platinum can go inside Gold. Both are possible.

questions.qe: Syllogism (3/5): Statements: No Red is Blue. Some Blue are Pink.
questions.qh: न्याय निगमन (3/5): कथन: कोई लाल नीला नहीं है। कुछ नीले गुलाबी हैं।
questions.e: Shortcut: Pink का वो हिस्सा जो Blue है, कभी Red नहीं हो सकता। इसलिए Some Pink are not Red हमेशा सही होगा।

questions.qe: Syllogism (4/5): Statements: Only Mango are Apple. Some Mango are Sweet.
questions.qh: न्याय निगमन (4/5): कथन: केवल आम सेब हैं। कुछ आम मीठे हैं।
questions.e: Concept: 'Only A are B' means B belongs only to A and cannot touch anyone else. So Apple can never be Sweet.

questions.qe: Syllogism (5/5): Statements: All A are B. No B is C. All C are D.
questions.qh: न्याय निगमन (5/5): कथन: सभी A, B हैं। कोई B, C नहीं है। सभी C, D हैं।
questions.e: Logic: A is inside B, so no A can touch C (I true). D का वो हिस्सा जो C है, वो B नहीं हो सकता (II true).

questions.qe: Coding-Decoding: If 'ROSE' is coded as '6821' and 'CHAIR' is '73456', how is 'SEARCH' coded?
questions.qh: कोडिंग: यदि 'ROSE' का कोड '6821' और 'CHAIR' का '73456' है, तो 'SEARCH' का कोड?
questions.e: Direct Coding: S=2, E=1, A=4, R=6, C=7, B=3. Match the letters to get 214673.

questions.qe: Direction Sense: A man starts walking East. After 10m he turns Right, then after 5m turns Right again. Finally, after 10m he turns Left. Facing direction?
questions.qh: दिशा ज्ञान: एक व्यक्ति पूर्व की ओर चलता है। 10m बाद दाएं मुड़ता है, फिर 5m बाद फिर दाएं मुड़ता है। अंत में 10m बाद बाएं मुड़ता है। मुख की दिशा?
questions.e: Shortcut: East -> Right(South) -> Right(West) -> Left(South). Final direction is South.

questions.qe: Blood Relation: Introducing a boy, a girl said, 'He is the son of the daughter of the father of my uncle.' How is the boy related to the girl?
questions.qh: रक्त संबंध: एक लड़के का परिचय कराते हुए, एक लड़की ने कहा, 'वह मेरे चाचा के पिता की बेटी का बेटा है।' लड़का लड़की से कैसे संबंधित है?
questions.e: Logic: Father of uncle = Grandfather. Daughter of grandfather = Aunt (Bua). Aunt's son = Brother (Cousin).
Logic: Square root. √64 = 8. √289 = 17.

questions.qe: Classification: Odd one out: Iron, Copper, Zinc, Mercury?
questions.qh: वर्गीकरण: विषम चुनें: लोहा, तांबा, जस्ता, पारा?
questions.e: Logic: Mercury (पारा) कमरे के तापमान पर तरल (Liquid) होता है, बाकी सब ठोस (Solid) हैं.

questions.qe: Venn Diagram: State, Country, City.
questions.qh: वेन आरेख: राज्य, देश, शहर।
questions.e: Logic: City is inside State, and State is inside Country. Three concentric circles.

questions.qe: Series (Alphabet): ABD, DGK, HMS, MTB, ?
questions.qh: श्रृंखला: ABD, DGK, HMS, MTB, ?
questions.e: Logic: +3, +4, +5, +6 pattern for the first letter. Next is M+6 = S. Similar logic for others.

questions.qe: Coding: If 'DANGER' is '11-8-21-14-12-25', find 'SAFE'.
Direction: Shadow at Sunrise is to the left of Rohan. Face direction?
questions.qh: दिशा: सूर्योदय के समय रोहन की छाया उसके बाएं है। मुख की दिशा?
questions.e: Logic: Sunrise shadow = West. Left is West means face is North.

questions.qe: Blood Relation: How is my father's mother's only son's wife related to me?
questions.qh: रक्त संबंध: मेरे पिता की माँ के इकलौते बेटे की पत्नी मेरी क्या लगी?
questions.e: Logic: Father's mother's only son = Father. Father's wife = Mother.

questions.qe: Analogy: Book : Author :: Statue : ?
questions.qh: सादृश्यता: पुस्तक : लेखक :: मूर्ति : ?
questions.e: Logic: Creator relationship. Sculptor (मूर्तिकार) makes statues.

questions.qe: Classification: Odd: 121, 144, 169, 181?
questions.e: Logic: 121(11²), 144(12²), 169(13²) are squares. 181 is not a square.

questions.qe: Venn Diagram: Whale, Mammal, Fish.
questions.qh: वेन आरेख: व्हेल, स्तनधारी, मछली।
questions.e: Logic: Whale is a mammal. Fish is a separate category.
Pattern: Perfect cubes. 1³, 2³, 3³, 4³, 5³=125.

questions.qe: Direction: 3km North, 4km East. Shortest distance from start?
questions.qh: दिशा: 3km उत्तर, 4km पूर्व। शुरू से न्यूनतम दूरी?
questions.e: Logic: Pythagoras. √(3²+4²) = 5km.

questions.qe: Analogy: Bird : Wings :: Fish : ?
questions.qh: सादृश्यता: पक्षी : पंख :: मछली : ?
questions.e: Logic: Movement organ. Fish use Fins (पंख/फिन) to swim.

questions.qe: Blood Relation: Husband of sister of father?
questions.qh: रक्त संबंध: पिता की बहन का पति?
questions.e: Logic: Father's sister = Aunt (Bua). Her husband = Uncle (Phupha).

questions.qe: Classification: Odd: Apple, Mango, Potato, Orange?
questions.qh: वर्गीकरण: विषम: सेब, आम, आलू, संतरा?
questions.e: Logic: Potato is a vegetable, others are fruits.

questions.qe: Series (Alphabet): Z, X, V, T, ?
questions.qh: श्रृंखला: Z, X, V, T, ?
questions.e: Pattern: -2 jump. T-2 = R.

questions.qe: Coding: If 'A'=1, 'CAT'=24, 'DOG'=?
questions.qh: कोडिंग: यदि 'A'=1, 'CAT'=24, तो 'DOG' का कोड?
questions.e: Logic: Sum of positions. D(4)+O(15)+G(7) = 26.

questions.qe: Venn Diagram: Students, Boys, Girls.
questions.qh: वेन आरेख: छात्र, लड़के, लड़कियाँ।
o: Boys and Girls separate inside Students
questions.e: Logic: Boys and Girls are separate but both are Students.

questions.qe: Syllogism: All Stars are Moons. All Moons are Planets.
questions.qh: न्याय निगमन: सभी तारे चंद्रमा हैं। सभी चंद्रमा ग्रह हैं।
questions.e: Logic: Stars inside Moon inside Planets. Both conclusions follow.

questions.qe: Analogy: Teacher : School :: Doctor : ?
questions.qh: सादृश्यता: शिक्षक : स्कूल :: डॉक्टर : ?
questions.e: Logic: Workplace. Doctor works in a Hospital.

questions.qe: Classification: Odd: Keyboard, Mouse, Monitor, Printer?
questions.qh: वर्गीकरण: विषम: कीबोर्ड, माउस, मॉनिटर, प्रिंटर?
questions.e: Logic: Keyboard/Mouse are input. Monitor/Printer are output. This is a mixed list, check for Input vs Output logic.
